title: Sales Manager
description:
Roles and Responsibilities 
 Manage sales activities, including lead generation, customer relationship building, and proposal development.
 Provide technical support to customers through pre-sales activities such as RFQs (Requests For Quotation) and proposal management.
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify new opportunities and develop techno-commercial solutions for customers.
 Desired Candidate Profile 
 2-7 years of experience in industrial automation industry with a focus on sales or marketing roles.
 Strong understanding of product marketing, technical marketing, market research, technical sales, competitor analysis, OEM sales/marketing concepts.

Key Skills: Techno-commercial,Business development,Generation,OEM sales,Research,OEM marketing,Management,Proposal management
